name: n8n Error Alerts: Slack with repeat suppression

parameters.content:
## Error alerts
Set this workflow as the **Error Workflow** of every workflow you want watched, and keep it **active** (n8n 2.x skips an inactive error workflow). The first failure posts right away. The same workflow, node and message within `ALERT_REPEAT_WINDOW_MINUTES` is only counted.

## Repeat check
Every 5 minutes: for each error whose window has ended, one summary with the repeat count and the latest run, posted one at a time. A group is only forgotten after Slack accepted its message.
